# Entity card

Figma: `Entity card`, node `7661:13220` (page Components, `1:28`).
12 variants - `content type[4]` x `selected[3]` - plus a boolean `tags` property outside
the axes, so the real state count is 24.

A person (or other entity) in a selectable card, with an optional status tag.

**Only `content type=Person` / `selected=Default` is measured.**

## Markup

```html
<div class="v27-entity-card">
  <div class="v27-entity-card__body">
    <span class="v27-avatar-compact__face"><img src="/people/john.jpg" alt="" /></span>
    <div class="v27-header-display__text">
      <span class="v27-entity-card__name">
        John Smith <span class="v27-entity-card__ref">(123456)</span>
      </span>
      <span class="v27-header-display__subtitle">Graphic Designer, Graphic Design</span>
    </div>
  </div>
  <span class="v27-tag v27-tag--positive">
    <svg class="v27-tag__icon" viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true"></svg>
    Positive
  </span>
</div>
```

If the card is selectable, make it a real control - a `<button>`, or a `<label>` wrapping a
checkbox. A clickable `<div>` is not reachable by keyboard.

The card composes [Header display](HeaderDisplay.md)'s text column and a [Tag](Tags.md);
neither is re-implemented.

## Classes

| Class | What it is |
|---|---|
| `.v27-entity-card` | the card |
| `.v27-entity-card__body` | avatar and text |
| `.v27-entity-card__name` | the name line |
| `.v27-entity-card__ref` | the inline reference number |

## Values

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| padding | `--v27-spacing-sm` (12px) |
| gap | `--v27-spacing-s` (8px) |
| radius | `--v27-radius-m` (8px) |
| border | 1px `Border/Default` |
| avatar | `--v27-size-l` (32px) |
| name | Base bold - Outfit 16 / 600 / 20 |
| reference | XS - 12 / 400, on the name's 20px baseline |
| subtitle | Sm |

The name line runs **two type styles in one text node** - a 16px semibold name and a 12px
regular reference sharing a baseline. That is why it has its own class rather than reusing
Header display's title.

The card fills with a raw white rather than `Background/Primary`, so it does not follow
dark mode - FINDINGS.md #30.

## What is not built

- **The other three content types.** They put different content in the same box; none was
  measured.
- **The two remaining `selected` states.** `Background/Secondary` (`#fafafa`) appears in the
  set's variables and is very likely the selected fill - but "very likely" is not measured,
  and a selection state that is wrong is worse than one that is absent.

## All classes in this component

`.v27-entity-card`, `.v27-entity-card__body`, `.v27-entity-card__name`, `.v27-entity-card__ref`
